title: Host ACL
intro: Access lists that protect the appliance itself (SSH, the web UI and API, SNMP, routing sessions, DNS and NTP served by the box). The agent renders them into the nftables table inet vrx: one chain per attachment, established connections first, then the anti-lockout rule, then your rules, each with a counter.
readonly: Your role cannot change the configuration

banner.enabledSourcesIfaces: Anti-lockout: management TCP {{ports}} from {{sources}} on {{interfaces}} is always accepted.
banner.enabledSourcesAnyIface: Anti-lockout: management TCP {{ports}} from {{sources}} on any interface is always accepted.
banner.enabledAnySourceIfaces: Anti-lockout: management TCP {{ports}} from any source on {{interfaces}} is always accepted.
banner.enabledAnySourceAnyIface: Anti-lockout: management TCP {{ports}} from any source on any interface is always accepted. Narrow the sources in Settings.
banner.disabled: The anti-lockout rule is off: a commit is refused if your own rules would drop management TCP {{ports}}.
banner.drift: The kernel table {{table}} no longer matches the applied configuration; the agent re-renders it on the next commit or resync.
banner.missing: The kernel table {{table}} is missing although host lists are attached.
banner.checkMode: Check mode: the agent validates the table {{table}} with nft -c but never loads it.

lists.name: Name
lists.exists: A host list with this name exists

attachments.empty: No list is attached; nothing is rendered.

settings.intro: How the input chains are rendered. The anti-lockout rule accepts management traffic before every rule; switched off, a commit is refused if the rules would drop it.
settings.saved: Saved to the candidate. Commit to apply.

rendered.unavailable: The agent does not report the host firewall.
rendered.noChains: No chains: no host list is attached.

interface.title: Interface
interface.help: Linux interface the packet arrives on (input) or leaves by (output); empty = any

log.title: Log
log.help: Log matches with the prefix vrx:<list>:<sequence>

chain.title: Hook
chain.help: input = traffic to the box, output = from the box, forward = routed by the Linux host stack

priority.title: Priority
priority.help: nftables chain priority; lower runs first

defaultInput.title: Default input policy
defaultInput.help: drop = only traffic a rule (or the anti-lockout rule) accepts reaches the host

allowIcmp.title: Allow ICMP
allowIcmp.help: Accept ICMP and ICMPv6 in input chains before the rules (IPv6 neighbour discovery is always accepted)

enabled.title: Anti-lockout rule
enabled.help: Accept management SSH/HTTPS at the top of every input chain. Off: the rules themselves must accept it (checked on commit)

sources.title: Management sources
sources.help: Prefixes management connections come from; empty = any source

interfaces.title: Management interfaces
interfaces.help: Linux interfaces management connections arrive on; empty = any interface

name.title: Object
name.help: Name of an address object or group (source, destination) or of a service object or group (service)
